name: Host behavior learning summaries (sls-proxy)
description: Supplementary coverage and count evidence only; never a substitute for raw host_exec ancestry.

notes: Group counts by source_event_type; legacy summaries without it describe exec. Network/file aggregates are not process-tree edges.
observed_count = suppressed_count + original_emitted_count only when counter_complete is true.
context_reemitted_count is separate; do not build PID edges from summaries.
learning_state and reason describe evidence gaps; missing originals do not imply no execution.
